entities.summary: Bryan Anthony Warrick is an American retired professional basketball player. He was a 6-foot-5-inch (196 cm) 218 pounds (99 kg) point guard and played collegiately at Saint Joseph's University where he was named to the East Coast Conference and Philadelphia Big 5 First Teams.
